QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] To the Temple of Time
QuestInfo.0: You must transform into a dragon and fly to the Temple of Time. According to #p2144006#, there is a Halflinger that can transform you into a dragon somewhere in Leafre of the Past.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2144009##k, a young Halflinger that reminds you of #p2082003#, will transform you if you eliminate the nearby monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You finished your preparations to reach the Temple of Time.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] Root of the Conspiracy quest

0.0: That's better. Now, what can I do you for?\r\n#L0##b(Doesn't he look kind of like #p2082003#? Is Tamil Corba's great-great-great-granddad?)#l\n#k
0.1: What're you looking at me like that for?\r\n#L0##bCould you transform me into a dragon? I need to get to the Temple of Time!#l\n#k
0.2: Are you crazy? The Temple of Time is the Black Mage's turf! You won't get out of there alive!\r\n#L0##bMaybe not, but I need to go there. No matter what.#l\n#k
0.3: If you say so. Look, the monsters around here kind of have me trapped. You eliminate them for me, and I'll turn you into a dragon.

yes.0: Drive off 30 #b#o8220018s# and 30 #b#o8220017s#. Shouldn't take you too long, right?

no.0: Sure. But I'm the only Halflinger here. Who else'll turn you into a dragon?

1.0: Looks like the coast is clear. Thanks!

yes.0: Give me a sec to get the magic ready. Heh heh...

mob.0: You finish your end of the bargain, and we'll talk! Or are you too weak to handle the monsters here?
